top_signals.title: Sidhu: Lot of Collaborative Opportunities In India
top_signals.summary: Canadian Minister of International Trade says they see a lot of collaborative opportunities in India especially in the field of energy, mining, and food security. Maninder Sidhu spoke to Haslinda Amin on the sidelines of the Bloomberg New Economy Forum in New Delhi. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: India Is a Power in the Middle: Jaishankar
top_signals.summary: India's Foreign Minister S. Jaishankar says he sees India as a "power in the middle" rather than a "middle power." (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Starknet introduces wallet privacy feature for DeFi activity
top_signals.summary: Starknet’s Shadow Accounts allow users to obscure connections between their main wallets and DeFi activity, though transactions remain visible onchain.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
